name: editorial-illustration-generator
title_zh: 把照片转成复古编辑插画，保留构图与主体关系
tagline_zh: 不是滤镜，是重绘。食物、建筑、人像都能变成日本档案版画或 Risograph 印刷风，但主体、比例。
tagline_en: Not a filter—a redraw. Food, architecture, portraits become Japanese archive prints or Risograph, yet subject.
desc_en: Transform any user-uploaded photo into a vintage editorial print illustration—not a photo filter. Use for food, beverage, landscape, architecture, portrait, or product images that need Japanese archive print, mid-century graphic, risograph, specimen-sheet, or handmade editorial-art direction while preserving source aspect ratio, composition, and subject relationships.
why_zh: 它先解析照片里的主体边界与空间关系，再按版画语法重构，而不是整张图套纹理。所以边缘干净、层次分明。
why_en: It parses subject boundaries and spatial relations first, then rebuilds in print grammar—no blanket texture. Edges stay clean.
limit_zh: 只接受单张照片输入，不支持多图合成或文字排版。输出是静态插画，不生成印刷分色文件或出血位。若原图主体过小或背景杂乱。
limit_en: Single photo input only; no multi-image compositing or typography. Output is static art, not print-ready separations or bleeds. Tiny subjects or.
title_en: Turn photos into vintage editorial illustrations, keeping.
